hiw_faq_description: Everything you need to know about how MicroMatch works.
hiw_faq_1_question: Do I need prior experience to volunteer on MicroMatch?
hiw_faq_1_answer: No! Many tasks include embedded just-in-time reference guides and style tips on the task page so you can contribute immediately with zero prior training.
hiw_faq_2_question: What happens if I cannot finish a claimed task in time?
hiw_faq_2_answer: Tasks have reservation timers. If a task expires before submission, it returns to the feed automatically so another volunteer can claim it without hurting your account.
hiw_faq_3_answer: NGO administrators manage a moderation queue. Once an NGO approves your submitted URL or file, your badge is minted and XP is credited automatically.
hiw_faq_4_answer: NGOs submit their tax/charity ID (e.g. IRS EIN). Admins review the submission enriched by ProPublica data to grant a Verified NGO badge on all their tasks.
